_doc: Opening books (05 s7.3 as patched by R0 B.33 A-162/A-163, R0 C2-14, AI-24) on the R0 B.6 start kit (Core, Refinery, Shipyard with launch pad, Vehicle Bay, 1 Harvester mining, 800 Ore / 300 Ice): 3 doctrines x 2 variants, picked by weighted draw on the AI RNG. Grammar and location tokens: 05 s7.3 (opening_book.gd, BuildPlanner.resolve_site). No storage_silo (O-4); every build outpost follows an order move to the same site and carries when: presence (AI-23 refuses a book that breaks it). A book hands over to the reactive planner (05 s7.5) after its last step, at the latest at book_end_s 300. Each *_standard is the 05 s7.3 listing with gates fitted to the measured income of a Normal bot in the SC-41 world after BUG-4 (cradle, slots 0 and 2, seed 41; first delivery 68 s): every step runs before the hand-over in both slots, except a deferred Expansion pair (order move + build outpost) at the end of a book, gated after 5:00, whose gate the reactive Expansion rule reads as the book's time (A-163). No gate is derived from stall_s. A 05 step that income or escort availability does not let run by 5:00 is cut and named in the book's _doc. Per-step times: the AI-24 PR.

build_orders._doc: vanguard_standard: 05 s7.3 (as patched) verbatim. Measured (SC-41 world): home-trap Outpost placed 2:50, set_replenish dart 3 at 4:22 in both slots; longest funds wait 44 s (ice_extractor). The contested Expansion pair (t>=420|ore>=900; Ore stays below 900 before 5:00) is the deferred tail: pending at the hand-over, its gate is the reactive Expansion rule's time (A-163).
vanguard_rush: AI-24 variant (05 s7.3 names *_rush): 2 Darts first, early home-trap Outpost (t>=60), then a Dart raid at 4:00; costs 1,250 Ore, completes with no stall.

bulwark_standard: 05 s7.3 (as patched: the home-trap Outpost pair replaces the 2 Pylons, the Extractor waits have:outpost>=1) with 2 fits. (1) The home-trap move goes out when ore>=520 (Outpost 450 x bulwark cost_ore 1.15, rounded to 5 by DoctrineResolver), so the escort finds the Outpost paid when it arrives: the escort Dart orbits the site at 200-650 m and leaves on fuel (AI-24 PR), so a funds wait at the site loses presence. (2) The home steps end at flak_battery: measured, the Outpost is placed 2:26 and the Flak 3:12 in both slots, and the Flak is paid from the 4:20 delivery, so the next 05 steps cannot be paid by 5:00. Cut (reactive phase, 05 s7.5 Pads / Defence): pad, hangar (have:pad>=1, C2-14), produce lancer 1, set_replenish dart 2, sensor_mast. The contested Expansion pair (t>=330) is the deferred tail: pending at the hand-over, its gate is the reactive Expansion rule's time (A-163).
bulwark_greedy: AI-24 variant: 2 extra Harvesters and the Pylon chain before the first Dart, home-trap Outpost at t>=120, tower after; costs 1,650 Ore.

foundry_standard: 05 s7.3 (as patched) without its contested Expansion pair: steps 1-11 and set_replenish harvester 6, in 05 order. Measured (SC-41 world): home-trap Outpost placed 3:08 / 3:12, last step 3:55 / 3:59. Cut: order move dart|scout to contested_field when t>=270 + build outpost when presence. Measured, the move goes out at 4:29 and no unit is present at the 2,365 m site by 5:00 (the only Dart is back refuelling after escorting the home Outpost); a pair pending at 5:00 with its 4:30 gate met fails SC-41 (A-163), and a gate after 5:00 would be a time 05 does not give. The reactive Expansion rule (05 s7.5, home fields < 30 %) covers it until a gate is ruled.
foundry_greedy: AI-24 variant: 2 Harvesters first, home-trap Outpost at t>=100, second Refinery, Extractor, Hauler, one tower; costs 2,100 Ore.
